name: Ensemble of the Ferapontov Monastery
description: Tucked into the countryside of Russia's Vologda region, the Ferapontov Monastery was founded in 1398 by Saint Ferapont and grew into a remarkably complete cluster of churches, bell tower and walls built between the 15th and 17th centuries. Its crisp, simple architecture is striking, but the real draw is inside: the Cathedral of the Nativity is covered in vivid frescoes by Dionisy, painted at the end of the 15th century.
